decisions.D1_policy: ONE MODULE. New game/src/sim/stealth/interior-lights.js owns the lit set AND the window aperture; render/interior.js and sim/stealth/system.js both import it. Ruling on the cap: LIT_CAP is removed as an ILLUMINATION cap (kept as the existing shadow cap of 1), because only one interior is built at a time and the max deduped lamp count is 14, so the 591-lamp province figure the comment cites is never simultaneous. Ruling on the fail-open: it MOVES INTO THE SHARED MODULE rather than being deleted, so a room declaring no lights is lit identically on both sides. REVERSIBLE: a measured frame-time regression from >5 point lights in a room would send the cap back — in which case it goes back on BOTH sides, from the shared module.
decisions.D2_constant: Re-derive interior ambient from glazed aperture of rooms that exist, not from a cellar that does not. ambient = dark_floor + sky_L * transmission(glazed_area/floor_area). prison/hold keep the dark value. Must keep the r3 critic 2x2 arm-01 lesson true: the ambient must stay far enough below lamp peak that the room still discriminates.
